arabic text: MUHAMAD KAY GHARANAY SE WAFADARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL SHOW OUR LOYALTY TO THE FAMILY OF MUHAMMAD (PBUH).

arabic text: AZAKHANE SAJAEIN GE AZADARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL DECORATE OUR CENTRES (IN BLACK CLOTH) AND WE WILL DO AZADARI.

arabic text: SHARAF HUMNE YEH PAYA HAI DUA E FATIMA HAIN HUM\nTO JAB TAK JAN BAAQI HAI KARENGE SHAH KA MATAM
english translation text: WE HAVE ATTAINED THE HONOUR OF BEING THE DU’A OF BIBI\nFATIMA. FOR AS LONG AS WE LIVE, WE WILL MOURN HUSSAIN.

arabic text: JANAB E SAYYADA SE YOON NAMAKHARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL SHOW OUR LOYALTY TO BIBI FATIMA IN THIS WAY

arabic text: BICHA KAR FARSH E MATAM HUM NAY DUNIYA KO BATAYA HAI\nYEH IZZAT OR YEH DAULAT SHAH E WALA KA SADQA HAI
english translation text: WE HAVE SHOWED THE WORLD THROUGH OUR MOURNING.\nALL THIS WEALTH AND RESPECT IS THROUGH HUSSAIN ONLY.

arabic text: FIDA DOLAT INHI KAY NAAM PER SARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL SACRIFICE ALL OUR WEALTH IN HUSSAIN’S NAME

arabic text: JULOOSO ME JARI ABBAS KA PARCHAM UTHAEIN GE\nWAHA(N’) NAAM E SAKINA PAR SABEELEIN BHI LAGAYEIN GE
english translation text: WE WILL CARRY THE FLAG OF ABBAS IN OUR PROCESSIONS.\nWE WILL GIVE OUT WATER IN THE NAME OF SAKINA.

arabic text: MUKAMAL MAH E GHUM KI AISE TAYARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL PREPARE FOR THE DAYS OF MOURNING IN THIS WAY

arabic text: JO ZEHRA SE KIYA HUM NAY WOHI WADA NIBHAEIN GE\nJAHAN JAYEIN GE GHAZI KA WAHAN PARCHAM LAGAYEIN GE
english translation text: WE WILL TRY AND FULFIL THE PROMISE MADE TO ZAHRA.\nWHEREVER WE GO WE WILL CARRY THE FLAG OF ABBAS.

arabic text: HUSSAINI QAFLAY KI AB ALAMDARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL CARRY THIS FLAG IN OUR HUSSAINI PROCESSIONS

arabic text: SABHI BHAI, BHATEEJE, BHANJAY MARAY GAYE PIYASE\nBAS IK HI ROZ ME HAAYE SITAM LAKHON SAHAY JIS NAY
english translation text: ALL OF HUSSAIN’S BROTHERS AND NEPHEWS WERE KILLED THIRSTY.\nTHE ONE WHO ENDURED COUNTLESS OPPRESSION ON ONE DAY.

arabic text: HUSSAIN IBN E ALI PE GIRYA O ZAARI KARENGE HUM
SAKINA KA DAR E SHABEER PY NAUHA SUNAEIN GE\nAZADARI KAY SADQAY ME HUMEIN MAULA BULAEIN GE
english translation text: HE WILL CALL US TO PERFORM AZADARI AT HIS SHRINE.\nWE WILL RECITE A EULOGY FOR SAKINA AT HIS SHRINE.

arabic text: YAQEENAN ROZA E SARWAR KI ZAWARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL NO DOUBT VISIT HIS SHRINE!

arabic text: YEH GHUM TO ARSALAN E GHUMZADA WIRSAY ME PAYA HAI\nHUMEIN ABBAS NAUHA MAA NAY LORI ME SUNAYA HAI
english translation text: ARSALAN, HEAVY HEARTEDLY SAYS, WE WERE TAUGHT TO MOURN FOR HUSSAIN BY\nOUR PARENTS. ABBAS (KARIM), MY MOTHER RECITED NOHAS AS LULLABIES TO ME.

arabic text: YEH WIRSA APNI NASLON ME YUN HI JAARI KARENGE HUM
english translation text: WE WILL NO DOUBT PASS THIS DOWN THROUGH OUR GENERATIONS.
